newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland revises down Jan 97 yr/yr CPI to 17.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Poland revises down Jan 97 yr/yr CPI to 17.8 pct.

text.p: Poland's Central Statistical Office (GUS) revised down January year-on-year price growth to 17.8 percent from 18.1 percent after an annual change in the consumer goods basket, a senior GUS official said on Monday.
"According to the methology of counting the consumer price index (CPI), the system of weights is changed annually," the head of GUS prices department Dorota Turek told Reuters.
She said the weights are based on household spending data from the previous year, which was available in late February.
This means that January figures published in February are preliminary and are being revised in March when final figures on the previous year's consumer spending are available, she said.
